questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code parses and validates the settings it loads? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Which setting can be overridden through an `ADS_PIPELINE_...` environment variable?
choices: Any variable named with the prefix, even for settings that appear in neither properties source
Only settings that are present in defaults.properties or the overrides file
Only settings in the overrides file, since defaults are fixed
Only the integer settings, because strings are not trimmed

questions.prompt: An operator passes an overrides path with a typo, so the file does not exist, and sets no environment variables. What happens at startup?
choices: IOException is thrown for the missing file
The service starts using only the packaged defaults
IllegalStateException is thrown because defaults.properties is missing
The service starts with all settings unset

questions.prompt: An override file sets `flush.interval.ms=50`. What does `load` do?
choices: Clamps the value to 100 and continues
Accepts it, since the value is a valid integer
Throws IllegalArgumentException describing the allowed range
Falls back to the default from defaults.properties and logs a warning
